subject: Compliance add-on commercial model — risk-share and onboarding fee options
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@carewellhealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@carewellhealth.com
Date: 2027-02-17 09:12 -0500
Subject: Compliance addon commercial options (audit logs / KMS/HSM / residency)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the dashboard-level tracing and the ability to scope KV-cache purging by tenant. Procurement asked me to capture a few commercial questions so we can surface them to legal and finance:

- Your standard line items for compliance: audit-log retention tiers, KMS seats vs per-request, HSM seat vs managed key-store, and data residency (US-only vs multi-region).
- Whether implementation (onboarding, SOC-2 evidence delivery, runbook handoff) is billed up-front or can be converted to credits against committed usage.
- Any discounting you offer for multi-year or committed throughput (tokens) when we take the full compliance stack.
- A risk-sharing / fallback mechanism if the HSM procurement is delayed (e.g., temporary encrypted keys with auditlog-only retention).

Can you send a short set of structured options (3 commercial pathways) we can present internally? I've attached our requirements matrix. We are trying to finalize preferred vendor shortlist by end of month.

Attachments: carewell_requirements_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Appreciate it — Sara
Sara Klein
Director, Procurement | CareWell Health
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@carewellhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-17 11:04 -05:00
Subject: Re: Compliance addon commercial options (audit logs / KMS/HSM / residency)

Sara — thanks for the detailed matrix. We reviewed and put together three clear commercial pathways below with high-level tradeoffs. I copied Ben and Jonas for implementation/billing detail and Laura for contracting.

1) Conservative (Minimal Upfront)
- Audit logs: monthly tiered pricing by retention (30 / 90 / 365 days) billed as a line item per GB/month.
- KMS: per-request pricing (no seat) with baseline included in hosted plan. HSM: add-on seat for production keys.
- Residency: US-only rolling deployment (no extra infra fee).
- Implementation: charged as one-time invoice (SOW) OR applied as a 6-month credit against committed tokens if you sign a 12-month usage commit.
- Discount: 10% on recurring inference fees with 12-month commit; additional 5% for multi-year.

2) Risk-share (Onboarding Credit + Performance SLA)
- All compliance addons bundled; Redwood takes partial implementation risk by converting 60% of onboarding fees into a refundable credit that is amortized over the first 6 months. If SLA targets missed (latency/ingest window) we increase credit to 100% for months 1-3.
- KMS/HSM: option to start with managed KMS per-request and convert to dedicated HSM seats within 90 days without rebilling of onboarding.
- Residency: priority rollout with committed capacity reservation; small onetime deployment fee.
- Discount: 15% blended discount across compliance bundle with a 24-month commit.

3) Capex-light (Upfront Implementation Waived)
- Onboarding fee waived in exchange for a higher minimum monthly throughput commit; compliance addons billed at standard rates but with steeper per-commit discount (up to 20%).
- KMS/HSM: HSM amortized as a monthly license to avoid capex.
- Residency: additional per-region monthly surcharge but reduced by commit size.

Next steps: Ben and Jonas — can you validate the feasibility of the risk-share SLA triggers and outline what evidence we need to guarantee the fallback if HSM procurement lags?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, Sara Klein <sara.klein@carewellhealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-18 08:22 -05:00
Subject: Re: Compliance addon commercial options — feasibility notes

Sara / team — quick technical + billing notes to make the pathways executable:

- HSM fallback: we can provision a temporary managed HSM (logical tenancy on shared appliance) within 7 business days. Full dedicated HSM seats take ~6-8 weeks (procurement + cert). The temporary HSM supports FIPS 140-2 level cryptographic ops and full audit logging; the only limitation is tenant isolation SLA (lower throughput SLA until dedicated seat).
- Billing: amortizing HSM as a monthly license vs one-time hardware purchase is straightforward on our billing engine. If you want a blended model (50% upfront, 50% amortized) we can support it.
- Audit logs: retention tiers are enforced in storage with separate line items and optional encryption-at-rest keying. If you choose to encrypt logs with customer-managed keys, we recommend the HSM seat (or bring-your-own-key via AWS KMS).
- Evidence delivery (SOC2 artifacts): standard package delivered over a shared drive; bespoke evidence delivery (per-tenant logs packaged for auditors) is an add-on and has a one-time fee.

I'll prepare a cost illustration for each pathway (attachment: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf) showing sample numbers for 500M tokens/month baseline.

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf (pdf)

-ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, Sara Klein <sara.klein@carewellhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-19 14:40 -05:00
Subject: Re: Compliance addon commercial options — credit structuring

Logged a couple of contract-oriented specifics below to make the finance team happy:

- Suggested credit cap: If we convert onboarding fees to credits under the Risk-share pathway, cap the refundable credit at the lesser of 50% of the first 6 months' committed spend or $150k, whichever is lower. This limits vendor exposure while still providing a meaningful concession.
- SLA trigger definitions: latency p95 > target for three consecutive days OR ingestion failure rate > 0.5% over a rolling 7-day window. If triggered, we escalate to a remediation credit equal to 20% of the monthly invoice until remediation is in place (max 3 months).
- HSM procurement delay: if customer cannot accept dedicated HSM within 90 days due to internal procurement, Redwood will: (a) provide managed HSM at no extra implementation cost for first 60 days, (b) offer a one-time $25k onboarding-credit if dedicated HSM not provisioned within 120 days.
- Pricing elasticity: propose a 12-month true-up clause to reconcile actual token usage vs committed throughput with a 10% tolerance band.

Laura — I'll need a short clause for the SOW stating scope of evidence delivery (what's included in 'SOC2 evidence' vs 'auditor-packaged logs').

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Deals Engineering
From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@carewellhealth.com>

Stephanie / Ben / Jonas — thanks, this is very helpful and exactly the level of detail our finance and legal teams wanted. A few follow-ups:

1) The Risk-share pathway looks promising. Can you send a redlineable term sheet that contains the credit cap and SLA triggers you proposed? We want to avoid ambiguous language around remission timelines.
2) For the HSM fallbacks, procurement needs written confirmation that managed HSM logs are functionally identical to dedicated HSM logs for audit purposes (we may still require additional attestation later).
3) Please include an explicit migration commitment (no re-onboarding fee) if we convert from managed HSM to dedicated HSM within 90 days.

If you can get that over by EOD Monday, procurement will circulate internally and we can target the vendor shortlist on Tuesday. Also looping Tom from Marketplace — Tom, is there any program-level discount you can layer on top for marketplace procurement?

Next: please upload the redlineable term sheet and the cost illustration to the Drive link and send the DocuSign stub when ready.

Thanks,
Sara
